dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
In Japanese, with title and map text also in English.
Publish date "昭和10年10月" taken from bottom, edition date from bottom right.
Conversion tables, tidal table, 3 inset charts.
Shows depths, low water areas, islands, peaks.
Inset chart 1. Kodi Road -- 2. Waingapu Road -- 3. Melolo Road.
